title: Amphoteric dual-role relation
statement: An amphoteric species is the same retained chemical carrier appearing in two separately held contexts, once in a valid acid role and once in a valid base role.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered amphoteric species, acid context, base context, context separation, duality, identity, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite chemical carrier for which two separately registered contexts contain a valid donor transition and a valid acceptor transition involving that same retained species identity.

choices.name: two-unrelated-species
choices.reason: Dual behavior must belong to one retained carrier identity.

choices.name: same-species-identity
choices.reason: The same species appears in both contexts.

choices.name: acid-label-without-event
choices.reason: A label does not establish donation.

choices.name: valid-donor-event
choices.reason: One context contains a conserved carrier donation.

choices.name: base-label-without-event
choices.reason: A label does not establish acceptance.

choices.name: valid-acceptor-event
choices.reason: Another context contains a conserved carrier acceptance.

choices.name: roles-conflated
choices.reason: Conflation can assert incompatible events simultaneously.

choices.name: contexts-separately-held
choices.reason: Each surrounding reaction identity remains explicit.

choices.name: one-role-only
choices.reason: One role does not close amphoteric behavior.

choices.name: both-roles-realized
choices.reason: Donor and acceptor witnesses both exist.

choices.name: species-changed-between-roles
choices.reason: A changed carrier does not establish dual capacity.

choices.name: species-identity-retained
choices.reason: The same carrier is compared before each event.

choices.name: amphoteric-label-only
choices.reason: A label cannot reproduce both contexts.

choices.name: dual-event-context-trace
choices.reason: Species, events and contexts remain held.

choices.name: free-dual-role-exception
choices.reason: An exception can admit any species.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Two valid opposite-role contexts determine the class.

induction_base: One retained species with one donor event and one acceptor event in distinct contexts supplies the first amphoteric record.
induction_step: Appending one context preserves the species identity and prior role traces; amphoteric closure persists only while both opposite roles remain realized.
exclusions: no acid/base dictionary, pH scale, equilibrium equation, dissociation constant, measured value or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no unpaired creation, copying or loss of a proton or electron carrier
no claim that structural closure alone fixes every solution-dependent strength or capacity value
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite chemical carrier for which two separately registered contexts contain a valid donor transition and a valid acceptor transition involving that same retained species identity.
operational_witnesses: the same species is donor in one event
the same species is acceptor in another event

target_rows.source_locator: official IUPAC source set anchored at A00306

falsification_condition: The claim fails if the authoritative amphoteric record lacks acid and base behavior by one species under retained contexts, or if a changed row is accepted.
